features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Standardized age using training mean and std; older customers tend to churn more.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous age signal centered at zero for linear margin.

features.name: credit_score_norm
features.description: Min-max normalized credit score within the observed range [350, 850].
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded smooth feature for linear projections.

features.name: balance_to_salary_log
features.description: Log-compressed balance over estimated salary ratio for smooth scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed ratio into a near-linear feature.

features.name: zero_balance_flag
features.description: Indicator that the account holds zero balance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Discrete shift contributing to a separable linear term.

features.name: inactive_senior_score
features.description: Continuous interaction between inactivity and older age (age relative to mean).
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite risk axis suitable for linear separator.

features.name: product_extremity
features.description: Distance from typical product count of 2; very low/high counts signal churn.
features.expected_model_benefit: Symmetric continuous severity score aligned with linear margins.

features.name: germany_flag_weighted
features.description: Germany geography indicator (known higher-churn region) blended with inactivity.

features.name: tenure_per_age_norm
features.description: Normalized tenure_age ratio scaled to [0,1] by max observed.

features.name: balance_zscore
features.description: Standardized balance using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearized balance signal centered at zero.

features.name: engagement_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of activity, card ownership, and product count breadth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Hand-crafted linear composite for SVM margin.

features.name: financial_stress_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of financial stress combining high balance with low salary and zero-product diversity; computed as weighted normalized signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth severity axis for linear separation of stressed accounts.

features.name: demographic_churn_propensity
features.description: Semantic composite reflecting demographic groups historically associated with attrition (older female customers in Germany), expressed as a continuous weighted score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single interpretable axis aligning multiple weak demographic signals for linear SVM.
